newsitem.title: UK: Pharmacia & Upjohn to reorganise R&D.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn to reorganise R&D.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc on Wednesday announced plans to reorganise its global research and development operations.
In a statement the company said it intended to create a global decision-making structure and place greater focus on bringing drug candidates through to early-stage development.

Pharmacia & Upjohn said it also intended to align its R&D more closely with its marketing and global supply operations, and integrate its clinical and regulatory functions more closely across the company.
Goran Ando, president of the group's R&D operation, said the company intended to focus on increasing efficiency and competitive capability.
"We intend to achieve these goals by prioritising key projects, rationalising resources and establishing clear accountabilities throughout our organisation."
The new global structure replaces a regional structure based on the company's centres in Kalamazoo in the U.S, Stockholm in Sweden and Milan in Italy.
Among a series of senior management changes, Pharmacia & Upjohn said Les Hudson had been appointed to head the world-wide discovery research operation.
Hudson had previous filled the same role for the company's Stockholm research arm.
Another senior appointment is Mike Tansey to head the clinical development operation. Tansey joined the company two years ago from Rhone Poulenc Rorer Inc.
The reorganisation of R&D is the latest of a string of initiatives announced since the appointment of Fred Hassan as president and chief executive officer in May.
